
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19623024" title="发布于 2026-02-25 09:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-带修饰符的简单 lambda 参数</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>上篇文章给大家分享了：</p>
<h1 class="postTitle"><span style="font-size: 14px"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" title="发布于 2026-02-18 11:33" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622981">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-field关键字</a></span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">今天继续给大家分享：</span><strong>带修饰符的简单 lambda 参数</strong></p>
<p class="p1">C# 14 对 lambda 语法一致性进行了增强。</p>
<p class="p2">&nbsp;它允许在“简单 lambda 参数”（未加括号的单参数写法）中使用参数修饰符，例如 <span class="s1">ref、<span class="s1">out、<span class="s1">in、<span class="s1">scoped 等。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="p2"><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px"><span class="s1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1">一、新旧写法对比</span></span></span></span></strong></p>
<p class="p2"><span class="s1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1">老的写法：</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="p2"><span class="s1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1">&nbsp; x =&gt; x * 2</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp; 如果想加修饰符：</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp; ref x =&gt; x + 1&nbsp; &nbsp;// ❌ 不允许</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp; 必须改成完整参数列表形式：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> x) =&gt; x + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></pre>
</div>
<p>新的写法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> x =&gt; x + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></pre>
</div>
<p>等价于</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> x) =&gt; x + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1">前提是类型可以推断。</p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">二、支持的修饰符</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">可以用于简单 lambda 参数的修饰符包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">ref</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">out</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">in</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">scoped</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">ref readonly</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">三、代码示例</span></strong></p>
<p>Ref参数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">delegate</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> RefAction(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x);

RefAction action </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> x =&gt; x++;</pre>
</div>
<p>In参数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">delegate</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> InAction(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x);

InAction action </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> x =&gt; Console.WriteLine(x);</pre>
</div>
<p>范围参数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Span&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; span = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">stackalloc</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];

ProcessSpan(scoped s </span>=&gt; s[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">四、典型适用场景</span></strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202602/23525-20260218121727102-1195526927.png" alt="image" width="763" height="222" loading="lazy"></p>
<p class="p1">“带修饰符的简单 lambda 参数”本质是：</p>
<blockquote>让 lambda 语法和方法参数语法更加统一。</blockquote>
<p class="p1">对于常规业务代码影响不大，但对：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">高性能代码</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">底层库开发</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">Span / ref 语义使用者</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;这是一个非常实用的增强。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;周国庆</p>
<p>20260225</p>
